title: Filesystem Kernel Modules Audit
description: Run the provided filesystem kernel modules audit script on a target Linux server and determine pass/fail based on whether any non-disabled or loaded modules are found.

playbook_input.description: Parameters the caller provides before execution

parameters.name: target_server
parameters.description: The hostname or IP address of the target Linux server to audit.

parameters.name: fs_type_blacklist
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of filesystem kernel module names that have known CVEs and should be flagged if not fully disabled.

parameters.name: fs_type_whitelist
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of filesystem kernel module names that are intentionally ignored by the audit.

playbook_output.description: The emit step's <result> block contains the pass/fail status.

fields.name: audit_result
fields.description: Result of the audit: 'pass' means no issues found; 'fail' means at least one module is not fully disabled or is loaded.

steps.name: Prepare script content and path
steps.function: Store the audit script content and destination path as facts. Script arrays for CVE blacklist and ignore whitelist are built from the provided parameters.

computations._script_content:
a_output=(); a_output2=(); a_modprope_config=(); a_excluded=(); a_available_modules=()
a_ignore=( {{ fs_type_whitelist | default('') | split(',') | map('trim') | reject('equalto', '') | join(' ') }} )
a_cve_exists=( {{ fs_type_blacklist | default('') | split(',') | map('trim') | reject('equalto', '') | join(' ') }} )
f_module_chk()
{
   l_out2=""; grep -Pq -- "\b$l_mod_name\b" <<< "${a_cve_exists[*]}" && l_out2=" <- CVE exists!"
   if ! grep -Pq -- '\bblacklist\h+'"$l_mod_name"'\b' <<< "${a_modprope_config[*]}"; then
      a_output2+=("  - Kernel module: \"$l_mod_name\" is not fully disabled $l_out2")
   elif ! grep -Pq -- '\binstall\h+'"$l_mod_name"'\h+\/bin\/(false|true)\b' <<< "${a_modprope_config[*]}"; then
      a_output2+=("  - Kernel module: \"$l_mod_name\" is not fully disabled $l_out2")
   fi
   if lsmod | grep "$l_mod_name" &> /dev/null; then
      l_output2+=("  - Kernel module: \"$l_mod_name\" is loaded" "")
   fi
}
while IFS= read -r -d $'\0' l_module_dir; do
   a_available_modules+=("$(basename "$l_module_dir")")
done < <(find "$(readlink -f /lib/modules/"$(uname -r)"/kernel/fs)" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d ! -empty -print0)
while IFS= read -r l_exclude; do
   if grep -Pq -- "\b$l_exclude\b" <<< "${a_cve_exists[*]}"; then
      a_output2+=("  - ** WARNING: kernel module: \"$l_exclude\" has a CVE and is currently mounted! **")
   elif grep -Pq -- "\b$l_exclude\b" <<< "${a_available_modules[*]}"; then
      a_output+=("  - Kernel module: \"$l_exclude\" is currently mounted - do NOT unload or disable")
   fi
   ! grep -Pq -- "\b$l_exclude\b" <<< "${a_ignore[*]}" && a_ignore+=("$l_exclude")
done < <(findmnt -knD | awk '{print $2}' | sort -u)
while IFS= read -r l_config; do
   a_modprope_config+=("$l_config")
done < <(modprobe --showconfig | grep -P '^\h*(blacklist|install)')
for l_mod_name in "${a_available_modules[@]}"; do
   [[ "$l_mod_name" =~ overlay ]] && l_mod_name="${l_mod_name::-2}"
   if grep -Pq -- "\b$l_mod_name\b" <<< "${a_ignore[*]}"; then
      a_excluded+=(" - Kernel module: \"$l_mod_name\"")
   else
      f_module_chk
   fi
done
[ "${#a_excluded[@]}" -gt 0 ] && printf '%s\n' "" " -- INFO --" "The following intentionally skipped" "${a_excluded[@]}"
if [ "${#a_output2[@]}" -le 0 ]; then
   printf '%s\n' "" "  - No unused filesystem kernel modules are enabled" "${a_output[@]}" ""
else
   printf '%s\n' "" "-- Audit Result: --" "  ** REVIEW the following **" "${a_output2[@]}"
   [ "${#a_output[@]}" -gt 0 ] && printf '%s\n' "" "-- Correctly set: --" "${a_output[@]}" ""
fi

steps.name: Copy audit script to target
steps.function: Place the audit script at the target path with execute permissions.

steps.name: Execute audit script
steps.function: Run the audit script and capture its output.

steps.name: Does the script report issues?
steps.function: Check if the audit script flagged any modules as not fully disabled or loaded.
steps.condition: The script output contains the string '** REVIEW the following **', indicating issues were found.

steps.name: Set audit result to fail
steps.function: Record that the audit found issues.

steps.name: Set audit result to pass
steps.function: Record that the audit found no issues.

steps.name: Emit error and fail
steps.function: Reached via the playbook's rescue block on any task failure. Outputs the error message and fails the play.

phases.name: Setup
phases.description: Store the audit script content and copy it to the target system.

phases.name: Script Execution
phases.description: Execute the filesystem kernel modules audit script on the target.

phases.name: Result Evaluation
phases.description: Inspect the script output to determine pass or fail status.

phases.name: Reporting
phases.description: Emit the structured final audit result.

phases.name: Error handling
phases.description: Reached when any step fails; records failure and halts execution.
